links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to dental crown questions (FKG and SMOG indices)
links.effect: Approximately 53% of responses were difficult to read overall; responses on longevity and maintenance were easier to read.
links.quote: Readability analyses indicated that approximately 53% of responses were difficult to read overall, though responses on longevity and maintenance were easier to read.

screen.reason: Empirical study assessing ChatGPT's performance, readability, and reliability on patient questions regarding dental crowns without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
